title: How are you, and the weather
objective: Answer “Hvordan går det?” and make one comment about the weather.
explanation: “Hvordan går det?” (How's it going?) is answered with “Det går godt, tak. Og dig?” The weather is the safest small talk in Denmark: “Det regner” (it's raining), “Det er koldt i dag”, “Sikke et vejr!” (What weather!). Note “det” as a dummy subject, just like English “it”.
sourceReference: Deepwater original starter course (2026-10-29), written for Echo; teacher review required before publishing.
